newsitem.title: GERMANY: German beet sugar content stays ahead of last year.
newsitem.headline: German beet sugar content stays ahead of last year.

text.p: The latest German sugar beet campaign report put average sugar content on December 6 at 18.19 percent versus 16.74 percent a year earlier.
But sugar beet deliveries to refineries were down to 24.03 million tonnes from 24.32 million a year earlier, sugar industry association WVZ said in its 11th weekly report.
WVZ maintained its forecast for final beet deliveries in the 1996/97 campaign of 25.80 million tonnes, down from 26.05 million in 1995/96.
WVZ runs weekly delivery updates until the end of the campaign in January.
Deliveries to refineries up to November 29 were 21.92 million tonnes, down from 22.29 million last year, and sugar content at that stage was 18.18 percent versus 16.74.
